issue.title: [FEAT]: Add MiniMax as an image generation provider

labels.name: repo-a88bcd25
labels.description: Request for support of a new LLM, Embedder, or Vector database

issue.body:
### What would you like to see?

Add **MiniMax** (`MiniMax-H3-Image`) as an Image Generation provider so `/img`, the generate-image agent skill, and the OpenAI-compatible image API can both generate and edit images.

AnythingLLM already supports MiniMax as an LLM provider (merged in #5450 / #5298), but Settings → AI Providers → Image Generation has no MiniMax option.

**Disclosure:** I work on MiniMax's community team. This is only about image generation for users who already use MiniMax for chat — not a new LLM provider.

### Why the existing providers are not enough

- The **OpenAI** image provider hard-codes `api.openai.com` and has no base URL setting (`server/utils/ImageGenerators/openAi/index.js`).
- The **LocalAI** provider can be pointed at `https://api.minimax.io/v1` with model `MiniMax-H3-Image` for text-to-image, but `editImage()` is hard-blocked unless the model is `flux.1-kontext-dev` (`server/utils/ImageGenerators/localAi/index.js`).
- There is no existing issue or PR for MiniMax image generation (searched 2026-11-10).

### Technical delta

Text-to-image is OpenAI-compatible: `POST /v1/images/generations` with `model`, `prompt`, `size`, `n`. The shared `BaseImageGenerator` already accepts either `url` or `b64_json`.

Image editing is **not** the OpenAI multipart `/images/edits` contract that `BaseImageGenerator.editImage` sends (`FormData` with `image` / `image[]` files). MiniMax expects JSON:

```http
POST /v1/images/edits
{ "model": "MiniMax-H3-Image", "prompt": "...", "images": [{ "image_url": "<url or data URI>" }], "size": "1024x1024" }
```

1–16 reference images. That is why a small dedicated provider (or at least an `editImage()` override) is needed, rather than Generic OpenAI / LocalAI.

Other API constraints that a dedicated provider should set, which the generic clients do not:

- The endpoint is not idempotent, so the OpenAI SDK's default `maxRetries: 2` must be set to `0`.
- A single request can take up to 600 seconds; the client timeout should be above that.
- Default size `1024x1024` is fine (pixel floor is 655,360).

Docs: https://platform.minimax.io  
Image API: https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/image-generation

### Proposed behavior (minimal)

- New `minimax` option under Settings → AI Providers → Image Generation.
- API key (dedicated `IMAGE_GEN_MINIMAX_API_KEY`, same pattern as other image providers).
- Configurable base URL for global `https://api.minimax.io/v1` and CN `https://api.minimaxi.com/v1`.
- Model default `MiniMax-H3-Image` (free-text is enough; `/v1/models` may not list the image model).
- Generate via the existing base class; override `editImage()` to send the JSON `images[].image_url` body.
- Register in `getImageGeneratorProvider`, `supportedImageGenerationProvider`, system settings, and the image-generation settings UI.

Happy to open a small PR once a maintainer has approved this approach on the issue, per CONTRIBUTING.

issue.title: feat: allow MiniMax-H3-Image to use IMAGE_SIZE=auto
issue.body:
### Before Submitting

- [x] I searched open and closed issues and discussions for an existing request.
- [x] I checked whether this already exists on the `dev` branch or latest source.
- [x] I understand that maintainers want a well-written issue or discussion before any code pull request.
- [x] This request is not a security vulnerability.

### Problem

I'm trying to use the existing OpenAI-compatible image engine with MiniMax-H3-Image (`https://api.minimax.io/v1`, model name `MiniMax-H3-Image`). The model supports `size=auto`, but Admin Settings > Images rejects `IMAGE_SIZE=auto` unless the model name matches `IMAGE_AUTO_SIZE_MODELS_REGEX_PATTERN`.

On current `dev`, that default is `^gpt-image`, so saving `IMAGE_SIZE=auto` with `MiniMax-H3-Image` fails.

### Desired Behavior

I would like Open WebUI to include `MiniMax-H3-Image` in the default `IMAGE_AUTO_SIZE_MODELS_REGEX_PATTERN`, so `IMAGE_SIZE=auto` can be saved and sent for that model, without changing the regex for `gpt-image*` models.

The current default is only set in `backend/open_webui/config.py`.

### Why This Matters

Users who point the built-in OpenAI image engine at MiniMax-H3-Image currently have to either pick a fixed `WxH` (and must stay above the model's pixel floor) or override `IMAGE_AUTO_SIZE_MODELS_REGEX_PATTERN` themselves. Adding the model to the default auto-size regex makes the existing OpenAI-compatible path work with auto sizing out of the box.

### Alternatives or Workarounds

Set `IMAGE_AUTO_SIZE_MODELS_REGEX_PATTERN` yourself, or use a fixed size such as `1024x1024` instead of `auto`.

issue.title: feat: support MiniMax-H3-Image generation and editing
issue.body: ## Summary Adds MiniMax-H3-Image to the CLI and SDK: text-to-image (`POST /v1/images/generations`) and image editing (`POST /v1/images/edits`). The default model stays `image-01`; H3 is opt-in with `--model MiniMax-H3-Image`. ```bash # text-to-image mmx image "An orange cat on a windowsill" --model MiniMax-H3-Image --aspect-ratio 16:9 --area 2K --n 2 mmx image "Poster" --model MiniMax-H3-Image --size 2720x1536 --output-format png --no-prompt-enhance # image editing: --image switches to /v1/images/edits (1-16 images; local file, URL, data URI or mm_file://) mmx image generate --model MiniMax-H3-Image --prompt "Replace the cat in Picture 1 with the dog in Picture 2" --image cat.jpg --image https://example.com/dog.png ``` ```ts await sdk.image.generate({ model: 'MiniMax-H3-Image', prompt: 'cat', aspect_ratio: '16:9', area: '2K' }); await sdk.image.generate({ model: 'MiniMax-H3-Image', prompt: 'swap', images: [{ image_url: 'https://...' }] }); ``` ## Design notes - Editing is `image generate --image` rather than a new `image edit` subcommand, so the `mmx image ""` shortcut (single-subcommand forwarding) keeps working. This mirrors `--image` on H3 video. - Validation and request building live in `src/image/h3.ts` (pure functions shared by CLI and SDK, same pattern as `src/video/v2.ts`). - Requests are checked locally against the documented limits: `size` WxH area 655,360–20,000,000 px and ratio 1:3–3:1; `size` WxH cannot be combined with `aspect_ratio`/`area`; `aspect_ratio` X:Y with integers 1–300; `n` 1–10; 1–16 reference images; 64 MiB file/body; `b64_json` total area (20 MP png / 80 MP jpeg·webp, `size auto` counted by `area`); `--no-prompt-enhance` is text-to-image only and needs a concrete size or ratio. - The endpoints are synchronous (server waits up to 600 s) and **not idempotent**, so the request timeout is at least 600 s and nothing is retried. - Partial success (HTTP 200 with some `data[].error`): successful images are saved, files keep their original index (`image_001`, `image_003`, ...), failures go to stderr (also with `--quiet`) and to `failures` / `failed_count` in JSON output. - All-failed responses (422/402/500): the trailing `(NNNN)` code in `error.message` is parsed for `/v1/images/*` only (1026/1027 → content filter, 2068 → plan message), and per-image reasons from `data[]` are added to the hint. - H3-only flags with `image-01`, and `--seed` / `--prompt-optimizer` / `--subject-ref` with H3, fail with a usage error. `--width/--height` are shorthand for `--size` on H3. `--response-format base64` is accepted as an alias of `b64_json`. - Out of scope: streaming output. API docs: [CN](https://minimax-zh-feat-h3image-release.mintlify.site/guides/image-generation), [Global](https://minimax-cac98058-feat-h3image-release.mintlify.site/guides/image-generation) ## Docs README.md, README_CN.md, SDK.md, skill/SKILL.md. ## Tests - `bun run typecheck`, `bun run lint` (0 errors; existing warning in `test/sdk/speech.test.ts`), `bun run build`. - `bun test`: 674 pass, 1 fail. The failure (`Zed configuration > ... XDG_CONFIG_HOME`) also fails on `main` locally and is unrelated. - New: `test/image/h3.test.ts`, `test/errors/api-images.test.ts`; extended `test/commands/image/generate.test.ts` (mock server: partial failure, edits routing) and `test/sdk/image.test.ts`. - `--dry-run` checked for text-to-image, editing, `--no-prompt-enhance`, b64_json limits and the legacy `image-01` path. - Not yet run against the live API. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.

issue.title: [Bug] 配置同步后 Codex 通用配置未应用到 config.toml，需手动编辑保存一次
issue.body:
## 问题描述

通过配置同步（使用 WebDAV 同步）获得的 Codex 通用配置已经保存在 CC Switch 中，当前供应商也开启了通用配置，但部分配置没有写入 `~/.codex/config.toml`。需要再进入通用配置编辑器，手动编辑并保存一次，缺失配置才会落盘。

希望同步完成后就自动应用通用配置，不需要额外手动保存。

## 环境

- CC Switch CLI：`5.11.3`
- 系统：Linux / aarch64
- Codex CLI：`0.164.0`
- 当前 Codex 供应商已启用通用配置：`commonConfigEnabled = true`
- 发现问题时 Codex 的代理及 live takeover 均关闭

## 复现流程

1. 配置 Codex 通用片段，并为供应商开启通用配置。
2. 将配置同步到本机。
3. 确认 CC Switch 中的通用片段已经更新，当前供应商仍开启通用配置。
4. 检查 `~/.codex/config.toml`：部分通用配置没有写入。
5. 进入 Codex 通用配置编辑器，手动编辑并保存一次。
6. 再次检查 `config.toml`：此前缺失的配置已写入，与通用片段一致。

以下是本次实际缺失的配置项节选；不是完整配置，合并时应保留原有表和其他字段：

```toml
[features]
reasoning_effort_override = true

[otel]
metrics_exporter = "none"
```

## 实际结果与验证

- 数据库 `settings.common_config_codex` 中存在上述配置。
- 当前供应商的元数据为 `commonConfigEnabled: true`。
- 同步后的实际 `config.toml` 缺少上述两项，并不是所有通用配置都缺失。
- 手动重新保存通用配置后，两项均出现在实际文件中。
- 保存后运行 `codex features list` 成功，`reasoning_effort_override` 被识别并显示为 `true`（当前 Codex 将其标为 under development）。
- 对 OTEL，此处验证的是 `metrics_exporter = "none"` 正确落盘，并非通过实际遥测输出来判断。

## 预期结果

配置同步成功且当前供应商已开启通用配置时，应自动将通用片段应用到实际 Codex 配置文件；手动保存和同步后的应用结果应一致，同时保留不属于 CC Switch 管理范围的用户配置。

## 排查线索（基于 v5.11.3，供维护者确认）

普通 live 写入和“编辑通用配置后保存”似乎使用了不同的路径：

- [`prepare_codex_live_write()`](https://github.com/SaladDay/cc-switch-cli/blob/v5.11.3/src-tauri/src/services/provider/codex.rs#L464) 的 `_common_config_snippet`、`_previous_common_config_snippet`、`_apply_common_config` 参数没有被使用。
- [`codex_live::prepare()`](https://github.com/SaladDay/cc-switch-cli/blob/v5.11.3/src-tauri/src/services/provider/codex_live.rs#L168) 默认构建的是空 common patch。
- [`prepare_post_commit_action()` 中的相关分支](https://github.com/SaladDay/cc-switch-cli/blob/v5.11.3/src-tauri/src/services/provider/mod.rs#L1156) 只有在 `action.edit_common_config` 为 true 时才调用 `codex_live::common_patch()`。
- [通用配置保存路径](https://github.com/SaladDay/cc-switch-cli/blob/v5.11.3/src-tauri/src/services/provider/mod.rs#L1752) 会设置 `edit_common_config = true`。

这与“同步后缺失、重新保存后生效”的现象吻合，但尚未增加独立的自动化复现测试，具体同步调用链和修复方式请维护者进一步确认。

建议补充回归测试：同步/恢复一个启用 Codex 通用配置的供应商后，不经手动编辑保存，验证 `features` 和 `otel` 通用项已写入实际 `config.toml`。

issue.title: [Bug] Codex proxy falls back to the Anthropic transform when meta.apiFormat is absent - the "unset" state provider add fills with openai_responses - so a native Responses upstream gets POST /api/v1/messages and 403 "No permission to access model"
issue.body:
## 环境

- cc-switch-cli **5.11.3**（Linux x86_64，官方 install.sh 静态 musl 构建）
- daemon 托管代理：Codex route `127.0.0.1:15722` enabled，auto failover off
- Provider（codex app）：`api-format = responses`，`base_url = https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/v1`，model = `glm-5.3-flash`（智谱 GLM Coding Plan 官方 key）
- Codex CLI：0.164.0 / 0.165.0（均复现）

## 现象

同一 provider、同一 key、同一模型：

| 路径 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| **直连**：codex → `https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/v1`（wire_api="responses"） | ✅ 正常返回（codex exec 全链路通过） |
| **经代理**：codex → `http://127.0.0.1:15722` → 同一上游 | ❌ codex 反复 `Reconnecting... 1/5..5/5`，上游 403 |

## 代理日志证据（proxy_request_logs，6/6 次全部 403）


issue.title: sessions: manifest publish always fails on Windows with "Access is denied (os error 5)" — directory rename blocked by own in-directory lock handles
issue.body:
## Summary

On Windows, the session scan's manifest publication step always fails with `session manifest I/O failed at …\.gen-….building: Access is denied. (os error 5)`. The paged manifest publishes and retires snapshots via **directory-level renames**, but at rename time the process still holds open handles on lock files *inside the directory being renamed*. Windows refuses to rename a directory while any file below it is open (regardless of sharing mode), so publication and quarantine fail deterministically. POSIX allows this, which is why Linux/macOS are unaffected.

## Environment

- cc-switch-cli version: 5.11.3 (portable exe, build 2026-10-22)
- OS: Windows 11 Pro for Workstations, build 10.0.26200.9711, x64
- Repro conditions: brand-new `~/.cc-switch` (whole directory deleted and rebuilt) + a single process after a reboot — still reproduces 100%

## Reproduction

1. On Windows, run `cc-switch.exe sessions list -a claude -v` (the TUI session page triggers the same failure, e.g. under `session-pages-v1\claude\…`)
2. The command exits with code 1 and shows "会话扫描失败 / session scan failed"

Reproduces 100% of the time; independent of login state, reboots, or deleting the entire `~/.cc-switch` cache.

## Actual Behavior

```text
[DEBUG] [SESSION-STREAM-SCAN] provider=claude discovered=27 emitted=24 cache_hits=24 reparsed=3 … elapsed=6.8062ms
[DEBUG] [SESSION-CLI-PAGES] failed to retire completed namespace \\?\C:\Users\<user>\.cc-switch\session-cli-pages-v1\cli-…: corrupt session manifest: namespace quarantine rename did not complete
Error: failed to publish isolated session page snapshot: session manifest I/O failed at \\?\C:\Users\<user>\.cc-switch\session-cli-pages-v1\cli-…\claude\.gen-…-000010d4-0000000000000000.building: Access is denied. (os error 5)
```

Key observations:

- The PID embedded in the failing file name is the **current process itself** — single process, not cross-process contention
- `.gen-…` entries are actually **directories** (staging dirs holding a whole namespace snapshot); every failing operation is a directory-level rename/delete
- After the process exits, the leftover `.gen-*.gc` staging directory deletes fine with plain user permissions — the blocking handle belongs to the process itself, not to AV or another program
- The session list keeps working (reads the previously published manifest + SQLite cache), but every scan's incremental results are lost and the error banner pops each round

## Code-Level Confirmation

`src-tauri/src/session_manager/paged_manifest.rs` @ `b54a105` (main):

**Publish path** — the staging dir is renamed while the build's owner lock inside it is still open:

- L475: `let owner_lock = FileLock::exclusive(&staging_dir.join(BUILD_OWNER_FILE))?;` → stored in the builder (L489)
- L1708: `fs::rename(&self.staging_dir, &final_dir)` runs **before** `owner_lock` is first released (L1740 `self.owner_lock.take()`)
- → `ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED` on Windows → exactly the reported error

**Quarantine path** — same pattern one level up:

- `NamespaceCleanup::drop`: acquires `FileLock::try_exclusive(namespace_root.join(".namespace.lock"))` (L352), then calls `quarantine_into_batch(...)` (L361) → `fs::rename(namespace_root, target)` (L2621) while that in-directory lock is still held → rename denied → `"namespace quarantine rename did not complete"` (L367)

Lock files are opened with plain `OpenOptions::read+write+create` (`open_lock_file`, L2710), so the handles do carry `FILE_SHARE_DELETE` — but on Windows that is not sufficient: **renaming a directory fails while any descendant handle is open, sharing mode notwithstanding** (this matches Explorer's "file in use" behavior).

## Root Cause Verification (minimal local experiment)

Isolated PowerShell test on the same machine:

| Scenario | Directory rename result |
|---|---|
| No open handle inside the directory | ✅ OK |
| Any open handle on a file inside (read-only, even with `FILE_SHARE_DELETE`) | ❌ "Access to the path … is denied" (= os error 5) |
| Deleting the leftover `.gen-*.gc` directory after the process exits | ✅ OK |

Environment factors already ruled out: ACLs (user has FullControl over `~/.cc-switch`), Defender Controlled Folder Access (off), third-party AV (no detections; manual file ops in the same directory work), cross-process contention (single process, fresh store, after reboot).

## Suggested Fixes

1. Release the in-directory locks **before** renaming: `fs::rename(&self.staging_dir, &final_dir)` must run after `owner_lock.take()` (and the quarantine path must drop the namespace lock before `quarantine_into_batch`) — or hold these locks on files **outside** the directory being renamed (e.g. in the parent, keyed by generation)
2. Alternatively, fall back to copy + delete when rename returns `ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED`, or retry with backoff after releasing handles
3. If pages are mmap'd, unmap before publish/reclaim (active mappings also block deletion on Windows)
4. Long term: a `#[cfg(windows)]`-aware locking strategy for this store — POSIX-style "lock inside the dir + rename the dir" cannot work on Windows

## Impact

- No data loss; scanning (6.8 ms, 24/27 cache hits) and the session list render fine
- But manifest publication fails on **every** scan on Windows: incremental results never reach disk, the error banner appears every round, and leftover `.building` / `.gc` directories keep piling up

issue.title: [Bug] Codex Anthropic 转换在响应未完成时仍发送 response.completed，导致完成状态识别错误
issue.body:
## 环境

- 实际运行版本：cc-switch CLI `5.10.5`、Codex CLI `0.162.1`，Linux。
- 请求路径：Codex 的 OpenAI Responses 请求，经 cc-switch 转换为 Anthropic Messages 请求；上游响应再转换回 Responses SSE。
- 已检查 `v5.11.3` 与当前 `main`：相关处理仍然相同。此处对新版本的判断来自源码检查，尚未运行新版本的端到端复现。

## 问题

`streaming_codex_anthropic.rs::finalize()` 根据 Anthropic 的 `stop_reason` 设置响应状态。对于 `max_tokens`，转换结果为：

- `response.status = "incomplete"`
- `response.incomplete_details.reason = "max_output_tokens"`

随后仍然调用 `sse::response_completed(&response)`。该辅助函数把 SSE 事件名和 JSON 的 `type` 都固定为 `response.completed`。

因此会生成一个事件类型与响应状态不一致的终止事件：类型表示完成，响应内容表示未完成。

相关源码：

- [v5.11.3：finalize，473–485 行](https://github.com/SaladDay/cc-switch-cli/blob/v5.11.3/src-tauri/src/proxy/providers/streaming_codex_anthropic.rs#L473-L485)
- [v5.11.3：response_completed，49–53 行](https://github.com/SaladDay/cc-switch-cli/blob/v5.11.3/src-tauri/src/proxy/providers/codex_responses_sse.rs#L49-L53)
- [v5.10.5：相同的 finalize 处理](https://github.com/SaladDay/cc-switch-cli/blob/v5.10.5/src-tauri/src/proxy/providers/streaming_codex_anthropic.rs#L473-L485)

## 对 Codex 的影响

Codex CLI `0.162.1` 的 Responses SSE 解析器同时处理 `response.completed` 和 `response.incomplete`，但仅当事件类型为 `response.incomplete` 时检查 `incomplete_details.reason`。对于 `max_output_tokens`，这个分支会报告未完成响应错误。

当 cc-switch 发送 `response.completed` 时，这项检查被跳过。

[Codex rust-v0.162.1 对应解析逻辑，418–455 行](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/rust-v0.162.1/codex-rs/codex-api/src/sse/responses.rs#L418-L455)

## 实际观察与证据范围

在一次通过这条代理路径执行的真实多智能体任务中：

- 一个子 Agent 的最后一次模型响应记录了 `output_tokens = 8192`。
- 该子 Agent 随后产生 `task_complete`，没有错误，也没有任何 assistant 回答，`last_agent_message = null`。
- 父 Agent 收到 `completed: null`，请求子 Agent 补发结论，任务最终超时。

当时没有保存上游原始 SSE，因此还无法确认这一次响应的原始 `stop_reason`。以上运行现象与该源码路径吻合，具体因果关系仍需通过端到端验证确认。事件类型与状态不一致的问题可以直接从上述对应版本源码中确认。

## 预期行为

当 Anthropic 上游以 `max_tokens` 结束、转换后的 Responses 状态为 `incomplete` 时，应发送与该状态一致的 `response.incomplete` 事件，并保留 `incomplete_details.reason = "max_output_tokens"`，使 Codex 能正确识别这类未完成响应。

同样需要检查其他生成 `incomplete` 状态的终止路径，保证 SSE 事件名、JSON `type` 与响应状态一致。

## 建议验证

使用真实 Anthropic-compatible 上游触发一次达到输出上限的响应，检查代理输出的原始 SSE，再用 Codex CLI 验证是否得到明确的未完成响应错误。现有 `test_max_tokens_incomplete` 检查了响应状态和原因，建议同时检查终止事件类型。

没有附加内部服务地址、凭据或完整业务记录。

issue.title: fix(codex): omit unsupported MCP type field from generated TOML
issue.body:
## Summary
Codex rejects a `type` key in `[mcp_servers.<id>]` tables: it warns, and errors under `--strict-config`. `json_server_to_toml_table` wrote our internal `type` (stdio/http/sse) into every generated table.

- Stop writing `type` to the Codex TOML. It's still used internally to choose the core fields (`command`/`args`/`env`/`cwd` vs `url`/`http_headers`).
- Round-trip is preserved: `import_from_codex` already infers `type` when it's absent (`url` → http, otherwise stdio). Note: `sse` re-imports as `http`, which matches Codex itself, since it only supports streamable HTTP.

## Testing
- New unit test `codex_toml_omits_unsupported_type_field` (stdio / no type / http / sse → no `type` key, correct `command`/`url`).
- `cargo fmt --check` ✅
- `cargo test --lib` ✅ 4567 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored (after rebase onto current `main`). Note: `session_usage_codex::test_incremental_resume_keeps_replay_prefix_alignment` is intermittently flaky locally, independent of this change.
- Integration tests: the 7 failures in `import_export_sync`/`prompt_commands`/`provider_commands` are pre-existing on `main` in my environment (no default editor, official-provider usage template), unchanged by this PR.

Closes #496

## 问题

CC-Switch-CLI 的 Codex MCP 导出逻辑会将共用 MCP 定义中的 `type` 写入 `~/.codex/config.toml`。Codex TOML 不识别该字段：普通模式会产生 ignored-setting Warning，启用 `--strict-config` 时则会导致配置校验失败。

本机清理生成文件中的 `type` 后，三个 HTTP MCP 仍被 Codex 正确识别为 `streamable_http`。但导出函数会主动添加该字段，因此仅手工清理 live 配置或数据库内的 Codex 配置快照不能解决后续重新同步时的问题。

## 环境与上游核对

- 本机 CC-Switch-CLI：5.10.5
- 本机 Codex CLI：0.161.0
- 本机环境：Linux
- 已检查上游 v5.11.0 和 main（`b781987413279ccca6102ef0ad2a283fe364b566`），两者的 `src-tauri/src/mcp.rs` 仍包含相同的导出逻辑。

## 复现

1. 在 CC-Switch 中为 Codex 启用一个 HTTP MCP，然后同步到 Codex。
2. 检查生成的配置，可看到类似内容：

```toml
[mcp_servers.example]
type = "http"
url = "https://example.com/mcp"
```

3. 启动 Codex，可看到类似 Warning：

```text
Codex is ignoring 1 unrecognized configuration setting. Check for typos or deprecated settings.
  user (.../config.toml): `mcp_servers.example.type` is ignored.
```

本机实际遇到的是 github、prts_wiki、tavily 三个服务的该字段被忽略。删除这三行后，`codex mcp list --json` 仍将三个服务识别为 `streamable_http`。

以下命令可独立验证严格校验行为，不需要可用的 MCP 服务，也不会修改配置文件：

```sh
codex --strict-config \
  -c 'mcp_servers.type_repro.type="http"' \
  -c 'mcp_servers.type_repro.url="https://example.invalid/mcp"' \
  app-server --listen off
```

Codex 0.161.0 实测退出码为 1：

```text
Error: unknown configuration field `mcp_servers.type_repro.type` in -c/--config override
```

## 原因

[`json_server_to_toml_table()`](https://github.com/SaladDay/cc-switch-cli/blob/b781987413279ccca6102ef0ad2a283fe364b566/src-tauri/src/mcp.rs#L1111-L1122) 无条件写入：

```rust
let typ = spec.get("type").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("stdio");
t["type"] = toml_edit::value(typ);
```

批量同步 `sync_enabled_to_codex()` 和单服务同步 `sync_single_server_to_codex()` 都会使用该转换函数。因此 HTTP 和 stdio 导出都需要处理。

这不宜描述为 Codex 最近弃用了 `type`：至少在 [Codex 0.50.0 的解析结构](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/rust-v0.50.0/codex-rs/core/src/config_types.rs#L54-L80) 中，就没有这个 TOML 字段。HTTP/stdio 通过 `url`/`command` 区分。

[OpenAI PR #44691](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/44691) 新增的是对原本静默忽略的未知配置字段显示 Warning。已核对正式标签 0.155.0、0.155.1 尚无该 Warning，首次包含它的正式版本是 [0.156.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.156.0)（2026-09-22 UTC 发布，完整 changelog 包含 #44691）。[官方配置示例](https://developers.openai.com/learn/docs-mcp) 也只使用 `url`，不包含 `type`。

## 建议修复与验收

- 仅在 Codex TOML 导出时省略 `type`；保留 CC-Switch 共用 MCP 定义中的 `type`，以及其他客户端需要的字段。
- 保持 HTTP 的 `url` 和 `http_headers`、stdio 的 `command`/`args`/`env` 等接线不变。
- 覆盖 HTTP 和 stdio 的批量同步、单服务同步，确认生成结果不包含 `type`，也不会将 live 配置中已有的旧字段保留下来。
- 保持 [PR #85](https://github.com/SaladDay/cc-switch-cli/pull/85) 的 URL-only 导入行为及自定义字段保留行为。
- 对最小生成配置验证 Codex 严格校验通过，普通启动不再出现与 `type` 相关的 Warning。

影响边界：普通模式下，HTTP MCP 仍可根据 `url` 正确识别；本 Issue 报告的是配置 Warning、严格校验失败和同步后字段重新出现的问题。

issue.title: feat(skills): support exact commit install and update
issue.body:
## Behavior

Add optional exact-commit selection to Skill installation and updates:

```console
cc-switch skills install owner/repo:skills/name --source-commit <40-hex-sha>
cc-switch skills update <installed-skill> --source-commit <40-hex-sha>
```

- `--source-commit` accepts only a full 40-character hexadecimal SHA and normalizes it to lowercase.
- Commit-pinned installs require an explicit `owner/repo:path`. If the Skill is already installed, the command directs the user to `skills update`.
- Commit-pinned updates accept one repository-backed Skill only, conflict with `--all`, and reject local Skills.
- The selected SHA is recorded in the existing `readme_url`, so nested source paths remain unambiguous without a database schema change.
- The selection applies only to that command. A later update without `--source-commit` continues to follow the stored branch or repository default branch. An exact update preserves existing branch tracking.
- Existing install, update, check-update, TUI, and database behavior remains unchanged outside the new opt-in path.

The PR also gates two existing Unix-only OpenClaw symlink tests with `#[cfg(unix)]`. They currently prevent the Windows `cargo test --lib --no-default-features --no-run` CI step from compiling. Product code is unchanged by this guard.

## Validation

Windows, Rust 1.91.1:

- `cargo fmt --check`
- `git diff --check`
- `cargo check --lib --no-default-features`
- `cargo test --lib --no-default-features --no-run`
- `cargo check --bin cc-switch`
- 8 focused tests covering CLI parsing, SHA validation, commit archive URLs, nested-path disambiguation, duplicate installation, repository-only updates, and a local HTTP archive sequence for exact install, exact update, and a subsequent normal branch update.

The complete test suite was not run. Existing repository warnings remain unchanged.

## Scope

This PR intentionally does not include local-directory import, cross-process locking, runtime-file exclusion, a transactional file engine, automatic crash recovery, TUI changes, or a database schema bump.

issue.title: fix(proxy): keep mid-conversation system messages in place for prefix cache
issue.body:
## Summary

Stop merging mid-conversation `system` messages into one merged head message in the Anthropic → OpenAI Chat conversion.

`normalize_openai_system_messages()` collected every `role: "system"` message, removed them from their original positions, concatenated them, and inserted the result at index 0. Claude Code appends a system message on every turn (environment / system-reminder blocks such as `<total_tokens>`), so the merged head grew every turn. Because the change lands at the very beginning of the prompt, every turn invalidates the upstream prefix cache (DeepSeek / vLLM / SGLang radix cache) and the whole conversation is re-prefilled.

## Evidence

Measured against an OpenAI-compatible gateway (DeepSeek backend) with the same ~15k-token conversation, 4 turns, 2s apart:

| Path | Turn 1 | Turn 2 | Turn 3 | Turn 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Direct to upstream, mid-conversation `system` preserved | 0% | 98.5% | 98.4% | 98.3% |
| Through CC Switch (current code) | 0% | **0%** | **0%** | **0%** |
| Through CC Switch, same messages with `role: "user"` | 0% | 98.6% | 98.6% | 98.5% |

Captured upstream request bodies with the current code — the first message grows every turn:

```
turn 1: {"role":"system","content":"You are Claude Code.\n# Environment\ncwd=/tmp\n"}
turn 2: {"role":"system","content":"You are Claude Code.\n# Environment\ncwd=/tmp\n\n# Environment\ncwd=/tmp\n"}
turn 3: {"role":"system","content":"You are Claude Code.\n# Environment\ncwd=/tmp\n\n# Environment\ncwd=/tmp\n\n# Environment\ncwd=/tmp\n"}
```

The upstream accepts mid-conversation system messages natively (row 1), so no normalization is needed for compatibility on this route.

## Fix

Same approach as the desktop repo's merged fix (farion1231/cc-switch#6941):

- Join only the **top-level** `system` array into a single message. Its content is fixed for the whole conversation, so the head stays byte-stable across turns.
- Leave `system` messages inside `messages[]` exactly where the client put them.
- Remove `normalize_openai_system_messages()`.

## Tests

- `anthropic_to_openai_preserves_mid_conversation_system_in_place`
- `anthropic_to_openai_keeps_prefix_stable_when_a_turn_is_appended` — asserts the serialized messages of turn N are a prefix of turn N+1, which is the invariant upstream prefix caching depends on.

## Live verification

Claude Code against the gateway through the patched build: first turn cold, subsequent turns **99.8%** cache hit (253,696 cached / 462 new input tokens). Before the patch, large turns sat at 0–5%.

## 中文摘要

`normalize_openai_system_messages()` 会把对话中间每轮新增的 `system` 消息合并到 prompt 头部，导致前缀每轮变化、上游前缀缓存全部失效。本 PR 只合并顶层 `system` 数组，保留 `messages[]` 里 system 消息的原始位置，并删除该函数。实测同一会话命中率从 0–5% 提升到 99.8%。

issue.title: feat(sdk): let snapshot restore set DNS rebind protection
issue.body:
## TL;DR A restored sandbox always comes back with DNS rebind protection enabled, even when the source sandbox was created with it disabled. Hostnames that resolve to private addresses and are admitted by the network policy then fail with NXDOMAIN after restore. This adds an explicit restore option so the destination can keep protection off. ## Description - Rust: add `RestoreBuilder::network(|n| ...)` with `RestoreNetworkBuilder`, a restore network scope with policy, TCP and UDP connection limits, and `dns_rebind_protection(bool)`. It is built on the existing network builder. - Go: add `WithRestoreNetwork(RestoreNetworkOptions{...})` with the same fields, `RestoreConfig.DNSRebindProtection`, and the matching `dns_rebind_protection` field in the native restore options. Nil fields leave the matching setting unchanged. The restore `NetworkPolicy` validation (rules and default actions only) is unchanged. - Node: add `RestoreBuilder.network((n) => ...)` with `RestoreNetworkBuilder` (same four settings). - Python: add `network=RestoreNetwork(...)` to `Sandbox.restore()` and `restore_with_progress()`. A setting given both as a flat keyword and in `network` raises `ValueError`. - The existing flat setters are unchanged in every SDK and set the same values. - Like the other destination network controls (TCP/UDP connection limits), it is host-side only and omitted unless set. Omitted means the default (enabled), not the source sandbox's setting. - No wire or snapshot-format change: the value travels in the existing launch network config, so the released v0.7.11 runtime honours it. - Docs: the Rust, Go, TypeScript and Python networking and snapshot references document the scope. - The CLI is not included. - Related drafts #1883, #1887, #1888 and #1889 add other restore options and capture-side configuration retention. This change is independent of them (none of them adds a DNS restore option); I will rebase onto whichever lands first. ## Test Plan Unit tests: ```bash cargo test -p microsandbox --no-default-features --features local,net --lib -- restore_builder restore_dns_rebind cargo test -p microsandbox-go --lib restore cd sdk/go && go test -count=1 ./... cd sdk/node-ts && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npx vitest run tests/unit cd sdk/python && uv run maturin develop && uv run pytest tests/test_restore.py tests/test_create_stub.py cargo fmt --all -- --check cargo clippy -p microsandbox -p microsandbox-go -- -D warnings ``` Live restore on a Linux x86_64 host with KVM, official v0.7.11 runtime (`msb` and `libkrunfw` release assets, checksums verified), Rust SDK from this branch, image `ghcr.io/linuxcontainers/alpine:3.20`. The host resolver was a stub that answers `*.priv.test` with `10.9.8.7`; network policy `allow_all`. 1. issue.title: Faster checkpoints: skip never-populated guest RAM in full captures, keep the capture baseline after a durable restore

type.name: Feature
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

issue.body:
### Context

[OpenAgentCore](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/OpenAgentCore) is an open-source, self-hosted implementation of the OpenAI Agents API, and its local sandbox provider is built on microsandbox: each agent Session runs in a microsandbox VM. When a Session goes idle, we suspend it as a native checkpoint (`msb` v0.7.8 through the Go SDK). The next request restores that checkpoint. Restore is already fast (about 0.5 s). Suspend is now the slow step: a 4 GiB Session takes about 3.1 s to suspend, and about 2.5 s of that is memory capture. A comparable hosted microVM service pauses a sandbox with the same memory footprint in 0.5–0.9 s in our tests.

We found two places where capture cost tracks configured RAM, not the memory the guest actually changed. We'd like to fix both upstream and can do the implementation ourselves (details at the end).

### Measurements

Setup: `msb` v0.7.8 CLI with its own `MSB_HOME`, an Alibaba Cloud ECS VM with nested KVM (Xeon 6982P-C, 4 vCPU, 14 GiB, kernel 5.15, swap on, checkpoint disk ~570 MB/s sequential). Each sandbox has 2 vCPUs and an Alpine-based image, and writes ~640 MiB of random data to guest tmpfs. Each snapshot is `pause` followed by `snapshot create --full --integrity --guest-flush skip`, the options our provider uses. Each step:

1. First snapshot of the freshly booted sandbox.
2. Resume, write 100 MiB more, snapshot again. No restore in between, so the dirty baseline is kept.
3. Restore that snapshot as a new sandbox (default eager restore), write 100 MiB more, snapshot it.

Medians of 3 runs, with spread under 2 %. Times are in seconds.

| Sandbox memory | first snapshot | second snapshot (baseline kept) | restore | snapshot after restore | first snapshot on disk |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 GiB | 1.59 | 0.22 | 0.51 | 2.34 | 681 MiB |
| 2 GiB | 1.79 | 0.36 | 0.53 | 2.43 | 701 MiB |
| 4 GiB | 3.53 | 0.43 | 0.54 | 3.73 | 735 MiB |
| 8 GiB | 4.79 | 0.63 | 0.57 | 5.21 | 805 MiB |

Every case holds the same data, yet the first snapshot gets slower as memory grows. After a restore, a 100 MiB change costs as much as a full capture, about 9× the cost of the same change with the baseline kept.

### 1. Full capture reads never-populated guest RAM

`Vmm::capture_memory` ([libkrun `src/vmm/src/lib.rs`](https://github.com/superradcompany/libkrun/blob/b35c7e118d7a1e48c8fad103b258e64ff5c49147/src/vmm/src/lib.rs#L1781-L1822)) passes every registered guest-memory region to `stream_memory` for a `Full` plan. [`stream_memory`](https://github.com/superradcompany/libkrun/blob/b35c7e118d7a1e48c8fad103b258e64ff5c49147/src/vmm/src/memory_capture.rs#L76-L132) reads every chunk and zero-detects it afterwards. Only virtio-mem unplugged ranges are skipped. In our 4 GiB Sessions the guest has touched ~0.65 GiB. Capture still reads about 3.4 GiB of anonymous memory the guest never touched, faulting in the zero page on each read, and then scans it.

Suggestion: on Linux, check the host range of each chunk in `/proc/self/pagemap` before reading it. In an anonymous private mapping, a page that is neither present (bit 63) nor swapped (bit 62) reads as zero, so that range can go straight to `write_zero`. Unprivileged processes can read both bits. `mincore`, which `metrics.rs` already uses for residency, isn't enough here: it reports swapped-out anonymous pages as not resident, so they would be captured as zeros.

This only covers RAM with no file data behind it, such as freshly booted anonymous memory or the `PrivateMemoryBacking::zeroed` image. In a private mapping of a restored image, a non-present page means "same as the image", which is case 2 below. Other platforms would keep the current path.

Expected gain (estimate): for the 4 GiB case, at most the 1 GiB cost, so 3.53 s → ≤ ~1.6 s. The 1 GiB run still reads ~0.35 GiB that was never touched.

### 2. A durable restore drops the incremental-capture baseline

After a durable restore, the next capture is always full. `CheckpointCoordinator::plan_memory` ([`coordinator.rs`](https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/blob/7964c6488d5b2a06f7b6726ce1ff68e2255277cc/crates/runtime/lib/checkpoint/coordinator.rs#L1895-L1931)) falls back to `plan_full_memory_capture` for two reasons:

- `previous_memory` is set only by a capture made during this VM's lifetime ([L1084](https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/blob/7964c6488d5b2a06f7b6726ce1ff68e2255277cc/crates/runtime/lib/checkpoint/coordinator.rs#L1083-L1086)).
- The VMM has no `retained_memory_baseline()` for a durably restored image.

Local branches already keep a baseline for their next local capture. They restore through `PrivateMemoryBacking::new(..).with_capture_baseline()` ([`restore.rs`](https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/blob/7964c6488d5b2a06f7b6726ce1ff68e2255277cc/crates/runtime/lib/checkpoint/restore.rs#L186-L188)), and the coordinator adopts that baseline ([L778-L789](https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/blob/7964c6488d5b2a06f7b6726ce1ff68e2255277cc/crates/runtime/lib/checkpoint/coordinator.rs#L778-L789)). The durable paths don't. The eager path (`vm.set_memory_restore`, the default for `msb snapshot restore` and `RestoreSandbox`) and the forked path (`PrivateMemoryBacking::new(cached.file, regions)`, [restore.rs L331](https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/blob/7964c6488d5b2a06f7b6726ce1ff68e2255277cc/crates/runtime/lib/checkpoint/restore.rs#L297-L338)) both start without a baseline.

Suggestion: when a durable restore finishes, start dirty tracking from the restored image. On the forked path that is `.with_capture_baseline()`. On the eager path it happens once materialization is done. Then seed `previous_memory` and `previous_memory_objects` from the restored checkpoint's memory manifest, so that the next capture is incremental against it. The new checkpoint would then reference the restored checkpoint's memory objects. Keeping those objects alive is the caller's job: we would keep the source checkpoint until its successor is published.

Expected gain (measured above): the same 100 MiB change on a 4 GiB sandbox costs 0.43 s with a kept baseline and 3.73 s after a restore. Every suspend of a resumed Session is this second case, so in our workload it covers every suspend after the first.

### Offer

OpenAgentCore depends on microsandbox, so we'd like to do this work ourselves. If you agree with the direction, we can implement both changes with tests and send PRs: the capture change to `superradcompany/libkrun` and the restore and coordinator change here. If you'd prefer a different design, for example dirty tracking from boot against an all-zero baseline instead of a pagemap check, we're happy to follow it. We can also share the benchmark script.
